## Purpose
Cross-session telemetry layer for context-injection hooks. It records every hook firing (what file was injected, how many bytes, when resets happened) to `~/.claude-telemetry/` so an operator can audit context burn across all Claude sessions and repos.

## Map
- Event write API → `writer.mjs` · `writeEvent`, `writeIndexEntry`, `sessionFilePath`, `sessionFileSize`
- Storage path resolution (supports `CLAUDE_TELEMETRY_ROOT` override) → `writer.mjs` · `telemetryRoot`, `sessionsDir`, `indexPath`
- Disable switch (`CLAUDE_TELEMETRY_DISABLED=1`) → `writer.mjs` · `isDisabled`
- Back-compat frozen constants → `writer.mjs` · `TELEMETRY_ROOT`, `SESSIONS_DIR`, `INDEX_PATH`
- CLI viewer (per-session, cross-session, top files, hooks, resets, tail) → `cli.mjs` · `main`, `renderSessionSummary`, `renderTop`, `renderTail`, `renderHooks`, `renderResets`

## Dependencies / collaborators
- `hooks/` — the context-injection hooks call `writeEvent()` at their recording points; telemetry is downstream of every hook
- `~/.claude-telemetry/sessions/<sid>.jsonl` — append-only JSONL files, one per Claude session ID
- `~/.claude-telemetry/index.jsonl` — session-level boundary summaries written by `writeIndexEntry`

## Gotchas
- `writeEvent` swallows all errors by design — a throw must never block a hook, so telemetry failures are silent; check `return false` if you need to detect them
- `SESSIONS_DIR`, `TELEMETRY_ROOT`, and `INDEX_PATH` are frozen at import time for back-compat; use `telemetryRoot()` / `sessionsDir()` / `indexPath()` if you need env-redirection to work in subprocess-spawned hooks
- `CLAUDE_TELEMETRY_ROOT` must be set **before** the hook process spawns (not just before `writeEvent` is called) because the frozen constants are already resolved at import time
